scope: Three-zone MP native XModel identity control population
proofBoundary: Every source-consuming XModel requires an independent structural-walker endpoint equal to the exact pinned native source endpoint with zero walker blockers.
Inline XModel name pointers require exact equality between the source-walker XString and pinned native resolved XModel name.

Packed XModel name pointers consume no source XString bytes and are promoted only when the raw fixed-record name pointer is structurally classified as packed and the pinned native loader resolves the real XModel object to a non-null name.

All 226 zero-source top-level XModel references close only through the pinned native loader's resolved object identity; no source-byte name scan, adjacency inference, surface similarity, or visual matching is used.
Resolved process addresses are diagnostic only and are not persisted as cross-run identity.
This proves the three-zone MP control population, not the whole 215-zone available corpus or complete English retail population.
